description: Authoring-side field catalog for the edge-claim form. The deployed form is a claim-template LinkedResource (#vct) on the protocol entity did:ixo:entity:outcome-causal-link-v0; its content hash goes into the rubric's claimSchema.proof, and every $ref in rubric.json binds against a field listed here. Claim bodies are answers bags over these fields, canonicalized (sorted keys) so claimId = CIDv1(raw, sha256) of the bytes is reproducible.

fields.name: graphVersionRef
fields.description: Content address of the CausalGraphVersion the edge belongs to (urn:ixo:causal-graph:...).

fields.name: edgeId
fields.description: The edge under claim, e.g. e3-use-disease.

fields.name: sourceNodeLabel
fields.description: Human-readable label of the edge's source node (shown to AI check and reviewers).

fields.name: targetNodeLabel
fields.description: Human-readable label of the edge's target node.

fields.name: mechanism
fields.description: The mechanism narrative from the causal edge, verbatim.

fields.name: comparisonCoverageBps
fields.description: Integer bps: share of the outcome series covered by program-vs-comparison data (from the evidence graph's link coverage).

fields.name: supportingReceipts
fields.description: Receipt CIDs of verified supporting claims (e.g. the output claim's evaluation receipt) — the claim-supports-claim carrier. The graph oracle re-verifies each JWS and verdict class server-side.

fields.name: analystReportCid
fields.description: Analyst effect-evidence report attachment. When present, criterion OGC-104-ANALYST goes to the edge-analyst-check review task; when missing it scores whenMissing (0) deterministically.
